{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_numeric'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}')

# Check the distribution of revenue
print('\nRevenue summary:')
print(sales['revenue_numeric'].describe())"}
